newsitem.title: FINLAND: FINNISH FEB CONSUMER CONFIDENCE UP TO 15.9 PTS.
newsitem.headline: FINNISH FEB CONSUMER CONFIDENCE UP TO 15.9 PTS.

text.p: Finnish consumer confidence rose to 15.9 points in February from 15.5 in January, Statistics Finland (SF) said in a statement on Wednesday.
"Every other Finn said in February that the country's economy had improved during the past 12 months. As many believed it would also improve during the next 12 months," SF said.

Consumer confidence is measured as the average of estimates on five variables: personal finances in the past year and coming year, the Finnish economy in the past and the coming year, and how advantageous it is to buy durable goods.
The consumer confidence indicator was 13.8 points in December and November and 14.2 points in September.
